climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: An Észak-Dunántúl PDO for still wine, where the wider area is described as making white wines on limestone soil. Ezerjó is the most planted grape at 22%, ahead of Chardonnay at 10%, and is named as a traditional local variety there.
